fieldValues.title: A newcomer is oriented by a question-shaped, bounded read
fieldValues.move: Orientation becomes one bounded read: an agent asks in plain words and gets a short ranked set of records, each with a line on why it matched and a statement of what the read left out. A brief names the records it was built from and says outright that it is a pointer, never the answer, so an agent checks the source before claiming anything the brief does not hold.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: The cost of the tool list itself, which needs its own change on the tool surface (SP-26); and what a view hides by default (SP-24), beyond the read stating what it left out.
fieldValues.falsifier: A cold agent given a task still spends more than a fifth of its budget on orientation, or still answers from the brief alone on a question whose answer sits outside it, in three of five trial tasks.
source_ref: srs-context:With the brief loaded, agents answer from it alone
fieldValues.return_when: When five cold-start tasks have been run with the bounded read and the owner has seen the orientation cost and the brief-only answers for each.
